summary: Configured node1 with persistent 512 MiB zstd-compressed zram swap at priority 100. It remained enabled, active, and healthy after a verified node restart.
actions_performed: Created and enabled zram-swap.service under swap.target.
Activated /dev/zram0 as 512 MiB zstd-compressed swap with priority 100.
Restarted node1 safely and confirmed its boot identity changed.
Verified post-restart swap recovery and overall system health.

evidence.requirement: At least 512 MB of compressed in-memory swap
evidence.summary: Post-restart evidence shows /dev/zram0 using zstd with a 536870912-byte (512 MiB) device and active [SWAP] status.
The service was enabled under swap.target; after the changed boot identity, it was enabled, active, and successful with zram swap restored.
The post-restart kernel swap table shows /dev/zram0 at priority 100, with no disk-backed swap active.

Captured healthy baseline with boot ID ea4e3fbd-2329-47e3-ad4f-e4f4d82214b7, acknowledged the scheduled safe reboot, observed new boot ID 81b56971-f98a-4df2-96ee-38c81965f0dd, and verified recovered swap/service state with system health reported as running.
